rows: The ASCENT is an Excel-based platform supporting emissions mitigation strategies across India’s governance tiers — from villages to states. Built on IPCC and GPC methodologies, it simplifies GHG calculations and facilitates low-carbon development through integrated data, scenario planning and mitigation strategies

Click the Questionnaire button below to begin. 
Fill in the respective data based on the specified unit (e.g., City Area in square kilometers, Avg. Annual Rainfall in mm/year). Enter the Value and source of the data in the respective columns, blue-highlighted cells

Select growth factors for emission projections such as: 1) Population Growth 2) GDP Growth 3) Combined approach
This flexibility allows you to customize and estimate future emissions from the base to the target year.
Select climate action strategies based on emissions profiles and projections. Choose from inbuilt, customizable low-carbon strategies to build comprehensive emission reduction approach.
It provides a summary of emissions and with subsectoral breakdowns based on activity data. It provides comparisions between senarios for effective decision making (under improvement).
Offers a library of proxy data points for all sectors, serving as input for tools (currently under development).
